description: The web-everything project's merge policy as data (standards.governanceConfigurable, standards.pilotsOwnProjects): required checks come from the live GitHub ruleset on main (snapshot digest below); review and approval come from the house review loop, which records them as PR comments and labels, not as GitHub reviews (the ruleset has no pull_request rule). Tiers: CI runs agent-written tests on GitHub's runners (replayed); review verdicts and labels are written by the house bots (asserted).

sources.note: required_status_checks: test, smoke, daemon-soak, soak-replay-gate, merge-gate; merge_queue: merge_method MERGE, grouping ALLGREEN; fetched 2026-11-21

tested.description: every required check succeeded on the commit that landed

reviewed.description: an accepted independent review covers the final head (a drain re-stamp after a content-preserving rebase counts)

approved.description: review:accepted was applied by an approver who is not the author, and was still present at merge
